about: Batch 1: existing sourced research only. The ten rules already verified in the store (airline and hotel loyalty links, Amex transfers) plus Michaela's Chase Sapphire Reserve packet as converted by Argon (candidates in data/candidates). Nothing here adds a source term: every structured value below is transcribed from the named candidate's own summary or restriction text. Which restrictions decide who has a benefit is no longer listed here: since the safety correction each restriction and open question is classified at promotion (in the copy, from restriction_classes.json).

other.name: All other eligible purchases (a source's catch-all rate)

travel.name: Travel, as the issuer defines it

flights-direct.name: Flights bought directly from the airline

hotels-direct.name: Hotels booked directly with the hotel

portal-travel.name: Travel booked through the card issuer's own travel portal

not_structured.cb.csr.peloton-credit-and-10x: 10X applies only to purchases over $150 and up to 50,000 points; the earning block has no minimum purchase and no cap, so the rate is left as text rather than recorded without its limits. The $10/month credit shares the record with the rate.
not_structured.cb.csr.doordash-dashpass-and-promos: Several monthly promos of different amounts in one record; a credit block holds one amount per period.
not_structured.cb.csr.points-boost-portal-redemption: A redemption value that varies by inventory ('up to 2 cents per point'); there is no structure for redemption values.
not_structured.cand-csr-transfer-*: 14 transfer rules: the source does not publish a ratio, so none is recorded and no transfer amount can be calculated.
